ordered_candidate_plan.angle: IBM raises the floor of annual software growth guidance while leaving the ceiling unchanged. Separate delayed transaction-processing deals from management-described net new business before judging durable demand.
ordered_candidate_plan.evidence_plan: Use only sealed goal35-ibm Reuters facts, published 2026-10-21T20:12:00Z and known at 2026-10-21T22:27:23.029Z. Preserve the single Reuters origin and attribute Kavanaugh statements through Reuters. Annual SOFTWARE revenue growth outlook is about 7%-8% versus prior 6%-8%: lower bound raised, upper bound unchanged. Total Q3 revenue +4.7% to $17.10 billion versus $16.82 billion LSEG estimate, and software revenue +8.3% to $7.80 billion versus $7.62 billion estimate, are separate metrics. About 25% from deferred Q2 deals and remaining 75% net new business describe TRANSACTION PROCESSING revenue only, per Kavanaugh via Reuters; never all IBM/software revenue or growth contributions. Do not compute dollar contributions or organic growth. Code owns arithmetic. Reported extended-session share rise about 4% proves neither lasting demand nor the cause of the move. Missing: transaction-processing denominator/comparisons, normalized growth excluding deferred deals, margins/cash conversion, recurrence and independent company-release corroboration. No additional retrieval, requests, quotations or media.
ordered_candidate_plan.primary_reader_question: Does the higher IBM software outlook signal durable new demand, or partly the arrival of deals delayed from the previous quarter?
research_queries: IBM October 21 2026 software outlook transaction processing deferred Q2 net new business
ordered_candidate_plan.selection_rationale: Fresh software guidance and a reported narrow revenue composition support a useful current company question. Explain what improved and the limits of the deal-mix evidence. Distinct from handled oil and historical filing-reading explainers; other current company/FX reports remain separate operations. Single-source report truth is not independent event confirmation.

selection.selection_summary: Select only IBM. The raised software guidance floor and delayed-versus-new transaction-processing revenue warrant analysis; the ceiling did not rise and the revenue split does not cover all IBM.
